# Armor Training

*[Rules Glossary](../../index.md) > [Combat > Stats](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#ArmorTraining)*

Armor training allows you to use armor of a certain category without the following drawbacks. If you wear Light, Medium, or Heavy armor and lack training with it, you have Disadvantage on any [D20 Test](../../D20-Tests/D20-Test.md) that involves Strength or Dexterity, and you can't cast spells. If you use a Shield and lack training with it, you don't gain its AC bonus. *See also* "[Disadvantage](../../D20-Tests/Disadvantage.md)" and "Equipment" ("[Armor](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/equipment#Armor)").
